title: Linear Occupancy Homomorphisms for Discounted Markov Decision Processes
summary: We introduce linear occupancy homomorphisms (LOHs), a class of Markov decision process (MDP) transformations that defines the MDP homomorphism over the feasible occupancy measure space of MDPs. In contrast to classic MDP homomorphism frameworks, which are defined through mappings over the state and state-action spaces, LOHs map between occupancy measure spaces and are representable as linear transformation matrices that expose important structural properties of the homomorphism itself.
